title: did i have any database changes today ?

messages.content: did i have any database changes today ?

Yes — but data writes only, no schema/structure changes.

Today (2026-07-16) on the test branch you had two data-write sessions, both logged in `brain/changelog.md`:

1. **Hakan Dagtas** — 1 User record created (`buildprint data create user`), role Casino Manager, linked to a Senior Management employee.
2. **10 users across 10 departments** — batch User creation, each linked to an existing Employee from a distinct department with a random role (Super Admin excluded).

**No structure changes** — no data types, fields, option sets, or privacy rules were touched. These were `data create` operations (no savepoint coverage), not `apply` changes. None have passwords set, so login needs a reset/invite.

Net effect: DB now holds ~21 User records (UM page shows 19 due to filtering).
give me summary what has changed in crs brain today in terms of functionality can you ?

Here's what changed in the **CRS Brain app** today (2026-07-16) — functionality only, 41 commits plus some uncommitted wishlist work. Two working sessions:

## Buildprint cockpit — made it operate the CLI safely at $0 runtime
- **Hard safety gate** (`crs-brain/bp-guard.js`) — a PreToolUse deny-hook wired into every agent spawn. Blocks apply-to-live, `--force-apply`, `--no-check`, `sync --reset`, data deletes, `rm -rf`, `git reset --hard`, etc. Verified firing.
- **Enforced operating loop** in the bp prompt: `sync` → plan + your approval → per-step `savepoint → apply → check`. Test branch only.
- **Speed + eyes:** allowed local Node/Python scripting for fast selection/dedup; wired `agent-browser` for screenshots/theme testing (still needs `npm install -g agent-browser` to switch on).
- Disabled the 20-min auto-sync (`bpAutoTrack:false`) — it was creating stale "concurrent agent" noise.

## Progress Tree page (`public/tree.html`)
- All 46 modules in build-priority order; drag/↑↓ reorder, click-to-cycle status, editable 8-item definition-of-done checklist, expandable detail panel that aggregates brain knowledge.
- **Per-module Buildprint prompt generation** — type a request in plain language → Brain writes a proper bp prompt → auto-opens the bp chat with it pasted.

## Activity log + rollback
- Every action now recorded (`data/action-log.jsonl`); a PostToolUse hook (`bp-log.js`) auto-captures every buildprint/git command, indexed to the savepoint taken just before each apply.
- New **Activity Log page** (`public/activity.html`) — day-grouped timeline, search, filters, and a **⟲ Roll back** button that opens a bp chat pre-filled to restore the test branch to just before that action.

## Persistent memory (never-forget)
- Say "remember this / don't forget…" in any chat → a compile pass rewrites it into atomic `{category,title,fact}` entries, saved to `data/memory.json` (committed, cross-machine). Injected into every system prompt so the agent always honors it. New **Memory page** to view/add/forget entries.

## Chat UI polish
- Agent activity now folds into Buildprint-style collapsible **"Worked for Xs"** blocks (icon+label rows, expandable) instead of one box per tool.
- Claude-style responses, modern tables, file hover-download chips, viewer Back/Download buttons, inline images. Ingest fix: attachment content embedded inline (stops the filesystem hunt).

## Wishlist (`WISHLIST.md` + Wishlist page — uncommitted server work in progress)
- Hand-editable app-improvement todo list with a `/api/wishlist` GET/PUT backend that regenerates the markdown. Seeded with your P1s: daily Bubble-forum check, track `bubble.io/release-notes`, limit-aware task-loop auto-resume, and auto-fix Bubble-reported issues.

## Housekeeping
- Stopped tracking `crs-brain/node_modules` (per-OS native builds); prompt standard + 4 templates added under `brain/buildprint/`.

**Note:** all committed to `main` but **not pushed** — ~50 commits ahead of origin (push via GitHub Desktop). The wishlist `server.js`/`index.html` changes are still uncommitted.
